lcc_original: 上帝就對挪亞說：『凡有血肉的，我決定要結束他們的生命了，因爲全地都因了他們而滿有強暴；看吧，我要把他們、連全地、都毀滅【2】。
notes: 神→上帝: standard UNV/LCC difference for אֱלֹהִים (WH0430)

קֵץ כָּל-בָּשָׂר בָּא לְפָנַי ('his end has come before me') is heavily paraphrased in LCC as '我決定要結束他們的生命了' ('I have decided to end their lives'): WAH09001+WH06440 (לְפָנַי=before me) anchored to 我; WH0935+WTH8804 (בָּא=came) to 決定; WH07093 (קֵץ=end) to 要結束; 他們的生命了 is LCC expansion with no direct SN
{<WAH02009>} implicit in UNV (הִנְנִי); LCC makes it explicit as 看吧 — braces dropped per Rule 3
מִפְּנֵיהֶם (WAH04480+WH06440 = 'from before them / because of them') maps to LCC's 因了他們而; tags placed after 而
LCC uses 全地 twice for Hebrew הָאָרֶץ (WH0776); the 全 is LCC's elaboration, not a separate SN
